pages.markdown:
Digital Infrastructure Solutions
Digital infrastructure powers business operations: data centers, cloud, network, and edge computing.
Our platform provides end-to-end IT asset management with dashboards for power, cooling, and network.
Environmental sensors monitor temperature and humidity. Alerts notify teams before equipment failure.
Network management covers bandwidth utilization and capacity planning with SNMP integration.
